## Change

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change.

## Validation

- [ ] `python tools/validate_github.py`
- [ ] `python tools/validate_source.py`
- [ ] `python tools/build_all.py`
- [ ] Windows smoke test, when behavior changed
- [ ] macOS smoke test, when behavior changed

## Safety

- [ ] No original reference photos, credentials, certificates, or generated binaries are committed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and version files are updated when this is a release change
